verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of asset export. Nothing covers export formats (PNG, SVG, PDF), per-layer export presets, scale multipliers or slices. The only related items are a mention of SVG as an open standard for code inspection (an adjacent feature) and one community remark that a user 'could only export a layer'. That remark is too thin, and too negative about formats, to count as the product's own capability for this story.

support.subject: As a designer, I can export production assets — PNG, SVG, PDF, and more — with per-layer presets, scales, and slices
